correctness.rationale: Backward equations for u_±(x;s) with reversal a and sticky-wall clocks k,g give H(x;s)=H(0;s)cosh(zx), G=(s/z)H(0;s)sinh(zx), z²=s(s+2a), and midpoint transform L=k/[(k+s)cosh z+(k+2g+s)(s/z)sinh z]. Expanding through s² yields A1=B+ka and A2=ka²/6+Ca+E, so F=1-2kA2/A1² and E[T]/h=A1/k. Independent symbolic quotient differentiation gives F_a=-2k(Q-2ka/3)/(B+ka)^3. This strictly affine numerator has one positive zero iff Q>0; otherwise F strictly increases away from a=0. At k=g=1, independently computed a*=15/2, F*=14/23; high-a limit 2/3 follows leading coefficients. This is an analytic sign argument, not numerical extrapolation.
residual_risks: Symmetric walls, midpoint and unbiased orientation, independent exponential wall clocks and a bulk reversal rate; no asymmetric or non-Markov wall claim.
